name: fitting-room-bikini-selfie
image_purpose: Try-on outfit post and shopping opinion selfie

prompt.project_info: Create an authentic vertical UGC fitting-room mirror selfie for an approved adult, preserving the black triangle swim top, white pleated tennis skirt, retail try-on context, and casual phone realism.
prompt.main_subject: Clearly approved adult with natural slightly tousled hair, curvy feminine silhouette, defined waist and rounded hips, wearing a black triangle swim top and high-waisted white pleated tennis skirt with a visible store price tag. Hold a smartphone in one hand and gently check the skirt hem with the other.
prompt.composition_elements: Straight-on eye-level mirror selfie framed from mid-thigh to the top of the head. Shift weight to the back leg with one hip subtly relaxed, front leg slightly forward, head tilted, and a cute questioning expression. Include cream or light-gray fitting-room walls, large central mirror with side mirror, overhead lights, curtain edge, bench with personal items, and shoes on the floor. Vertical 9:16.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Bright even retail fitting-room lighting with realistic skin tones, minimal shadow distortion, natural fabric creases, and an authentic shopping moment.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic iPhone 15 Pro-style mirror selfie, 24mm wide lens, vertical 9:16, natural grain, unedited casual realism, accurate mirror reflection.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Authentic photorealistic vertical 9:16 fitting-room mirror selfie of a clearly approved adult with natural slightly tousled hair, curvy feminine silhouette, defined waist and rounded hips, wearing a black triangle swim top and high-waisted white pleated tennis skirt with a visible store price tag. She stands close to the mirror with weight shifted to the back leg, one hip relaxed, front leg slightly forward, head slightly tilted, one hand holding a phone and the other gently checking the skirt hem. Cream or light-gray fitting-room walls, central mirror with side mirror, bright overhead retail lighting, curtain edge, bench with personal items, shoes on floor, realistic skin and fabric texture, casual shopping mood.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexualized pose, erotic framing, exposed intimate areas, lingerie emphasis, fetish framing, minors, celebrity likeness, public figure likeness, distorted reflection, extra fingers, deformed, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, invented text, altered price tag

assets.name: fitting-room-bikini-selfie.jpg
assets.usage: Preserve the approved adult's hair, black swim top, white pleated skirt, price tag, phone, mirror, fitting-room environment, pose, and lighting.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Attach the required reference image. Preserve identity consistency, hair, outfit, store tag, phone, reflection, environment, and shopping narrative. The swim top, skirt, phone, and store props are replaceable assets but must retain the same try-on composition. Preserve supplied typography on the tag only; do not invent logos or text.

changes: Retained the reference-specified swim top and skirt while removing sexualized wording and emphasizing the retail try-on context.
